scope: Read-only comparison of persisted post language; no stored classifications; no provider calls, software tests, product code changes, classifier writes, deployment or spam deletions.

cohorts.known_roles: Any post by an account currently linked to a non-sentinel brand as official/staff/community. Role is metadata, not a ground-truth promotion or employment label.
cohorts.bai_associated: Body contains bounded, case-insensitive B.AI, BAI_AGI, or TRONEcostar; association is not itself a spam label.
cohorts.other: All remaining DB post bodies are an unlabelled collision-control population, not a genuine/legitimate ground-truth set.

measurements_before_results: Body length, link frequency, paragraph shape, first-person ownership language
Greeting; conversational fillers; game-changer; did-you-know; generic reassurance; generic CTA
Exact and URL/mention-normalized body reuse across distinct authors
Campaign markers and named destination versus transferable language rule
Co-occurrence of at least two distinct filler/reassurance families plus a link; do not declare spam solely from this
Compare overall and recent windows; inspect collisions in official/staff and a bounded deterministic sample outside cohorts
limits: At most two exploratory feature passes; preserve first-pass results. Do not turn discovery-cohort separation into held-out accuracy. No threshold tuning loop. This comparison can propose a rule, not certify safe automatic removal.
